author: Thomas Phillips / National Portrait Gallery, London
en: Painted portrait of John Dalton by Thomas Phillips, 1835, from the National Portrait Gallery, London. Commons records the artist's death in 1845 and marks the work and faithful reproduction public domain. This is a painting made during Dalton's lifetime, not a photograph.
zh: Thomas Phillips 于 1835 年绘制的约翰·道尔顿肖像，来源为 National Portrait Gallery, London。Commons 记载画家于 1845 年去世，并将作品及忠实复制标为公有领域。这是道尔顿在世时的绘画，不是照片。
